title: Evaluation System | GLA Online
text: Clear, Transparent & Outcome-Driven Evaluation Beyond just tests: formative quizzes, LMS-based activities, term-end exams, and transparent policies define progress at GLA Online At GLA Online, we follow a relative grading system based on a ten-point letter scale to ensure a fair and comprehensive assessment of learners' performance. Each letter grade reflects the level of academic achievement and carries corresponding grade points that contribute to Semester Grade Point Average (SGPA) and Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA). Assessment Structure Each course is evaluated out of 100 marks. Each practical/lab course is evaluated out of 100 marks in the term-end examination. Term-End Examination: 70% weightage Internal Assessment: 30% weightage The internal assessment includes formative assessments, practice quizzes, discussion forums, and other activities designed to reinforce learning and track continuous progress. Formative Assessments & Quizzes Formative assessments and quizzes are shared through the Learning Management System (LMS), enabling learners to submit their responses conveniently. Term-End Examinations Updated schedule and guidelines of term-end examinations are shared in advance via the academic calendar and official GLA Online portal. Notifications & Communication All exam-related notifications will be available on the Learning Management System (LMS) notice board. Learners are advised to check for updates regularly. Re-Evaluation Policy Students seeking re-evaluation of a course may apply online within the stipulated time frame by paying the applicable fee. Carry Over Examination In case a learner misses or fails an examination, he or she may appear for it in the subsequent attempt. Apply Now Apply Now

title: FAQ | GLA Online
text: FAQs FAQs Got Questions? We've Got Answers! General Examination Fee Payment & Finance LMS Result Declaration Degree/Bonafide Certificate Internship/Placement Formative Assessments Live Classes / Masterclasses Are the programs offered by GLA Online UGC-recognised? Yes. All programs offered by GLA Online are duly recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC). Degrees awarded through the online mode are valid and hold equivalence to regular on-campus degrees, in accordance with UGC regulations. Which programs are currently offered by GLA Online? GLA Online offers the following programs: Master of Business Administration (MBA) Master of Computer Applications (MCA) Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) Bachelor of Commerce (Hons.) Is there any difference between an online degree and a regular degree? No. As per UGC guidelines, a degree obtained through an approved online program from a recognized university is considered equivalent to a regular on-campus degree in all academic and professional aspects. What is the mode of teaching for GLA Online programs? All programs are delivered entirely through a Digital Learning Management System (LMS). The LMS provides access to pre-recorded video lectures, live interactive sessions, e-books, quizzes, formative assessments, and discussion forums for collaborative learning. How can I apply for an online course? Visit glaonlineadmission.com and select Apply Now . Choose your program and submit your contact details. Our admissions team will contact you with guidance on eligibility, required documents and the next steps. This website collects admissions enquiries; it does not provide an application login or collect registration fees. Is any entrance examination required for admission? Learners must have successfully completed 10+2 (Senior Secondary) education from a recognized board or equivalent institution. What is the eligibility criteria for postgraduate programs? Applicants must have successfully completed 10+2 from a recognized board to be eligible for GLA Online undergraduate programs. Are the online programs suitable for working professionals? Yes. GLA Online programs are designed to offer maximum flexibility, enabling learners—especially working professionals—to balance academic commitments with full-time employment. Are classes conducted live or through recorded sessions? Both modes are available. Live classes are conducted as per schedule, and recordings of these sessions are made available on the LMS for learners to access at their convenience. What is the fee structure?
